source_message.text:
Yes, that is right. The main board includes:

- ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module
- INA219 current monitor on the 3.3V rail
- USB-C connector for programming, plus an LDO for standalone operation
- Every JST connector for the power board, sensor board, display, PIR, touch, LEDs, buttons, and reset
- Supporting passives, including decoupling caps, pull-ups, series resistors, Schottky diodes, and the BOOT button

It has no sensors or power management, as those are located on the other boards.

source_message.text:
Thanks [FREELANCER_NAME_001], understood:
1. VRTC — agreed: leave it NC for v1, since this board has no external RTC chip. However, on the RTC subject, I believe I previously mixed up VRTC with VBACKUP. VBACKUP (pin 27) is the backup-power input that keeps the AXP2101's internal RTC running after the main battery is removed. Could you also bring VBACKUP out to a small test pad / via beside PWROK from item #10? This would allow us to later install a 100 µF cap (\~2-3 min hot-swap tolerance), a supercap (\~weeks), or a CR1220 coin cell (\~4 years) if we ever want actual time-keeping. Nothing needs to be populated now; only expose the pad.
2. Buttons (R16/R17/R18) — agreed, make all three pull-ups to 3V3 (active LOW: connector pin 1 remains GND, and pressing the button shorts GPIO to GND). I updated [URL_018] accordingly.
3. PIR (R19) and Touch (R20/R25) — the pull-down configuration is correct. Both AM312 (PIR) and TTP223 (touch) use push-pull active-HIGH outputs, meaning the sensor's internal driver overrides the 10 k pull-down while active. The pull-down to GND simply ensures a defined LOW state if the sensor is disconnected. No changes are required.
